question_text: A school automatically publish es event photographs in a searchable online gallery. Outline one ethical concern about this integration of technology into school life.
adaptation_rationale: Preserves privacy/consent reasoning while explicitly situating the question in ethical integration of computing into daily life; does not imply a separate social-media syllabus topic.
solution: Participants may not have meaningfully consented to public publication.; Search ability/copying can expose their identity or private activities beyond the original audience.
